programs.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough's Greatest Adventure
programs.desc: Sir David Attenborough, a great advocate of wildlife and popularizer of science, celebrates his 100th birthday.On this occasion, BBC Earth presents the extraordinary journey of this outstanding naturalist and traveler.

programs.title: Egyptian Tomb Hunting
programs.desc: British actor and history enthusiast Tony Robinson travels along the Nile in search of the most interesting tombs.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The program shows the everyday life of people in Canada and their struggles with the forces of nature.

programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle
programs.desc: Presenter, writer and adventurer Ben Fogle travels to different parts of the world to meet people who have decided to leave the comfort of Western civilization and start a new life.

programs.title: Ancient Powers
programs.desc: The creators of the six-episode series, using advanced computer graphics, will present the history of the five most powerful civilizations of antiquity: Egypt, China, India, Rome and Greece.Ancient powers have a lot in common.In the fight for survival and domination, they went through similar stages of development.They conquered new territories, built societies and political systems, as well as formed cultures, developed trade, ideas and the art of war.Viewers will learn about the latest archaeological research on ancient powers.
